source_title: Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 Release Date & Time
source_excerpt:
Black Clover has been going strong with its recent TV anime return in 2026. With such a strong adaptation by Studio Pierrot currently underway, we are looking forward to the release of Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5. After the exciting confrontation between Asta and the Ancient Devil, and his battle with the Supreme Ranking entities in previous episodes, we can't wait to see our main character unleash his full might on the Twin Devils of the First Gate of the Tree of Qliphoth. The most awaited moment, however, has to do with Magna, a fan favorite Black Bull with a big fight on the cards. Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 will be released on October 31, 2026, and official previews are already out via Studio Pierrot, showcasing a new synopsis and images from the episode.
Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 Will Be Released On October 31, 2026
Black Clover had a rocky anime run previously. While its anime first started in 2017, it officially went on hiatus in 2021 due to a lack of content for Studio Pierrot to adapt, and at the same time, because of restructuring within the studio itself. 5 years later, Studio Pierrot is stronger than ever before and has now decided to bring Asta's story back to TV.
On October 3, 2026, Black Clover Season 2 debuted with its first episode . Since then, we have enjoyed consistent weekly releases for Black Clover. Last week, we were treated to Black Clover Season 2 Episode 4, and this weekend, the debut of Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 is now around the corner. Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5, titled “The Best vs The Worst,” officially starts broadcasting on October 31, 2026. This will fall, as usual, on a Saturday. In Japan, this episode will premiere on broadcasting networks all around the country starting at 11 PM Japan Standard Time. In the US, this release will fall on October 31, 2026, and will have to catch its premiere at 8 AM Pacific Time, or 11 AM Eastern Time.
For American viewers as well as international fans, Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 will be available to stream on Crunchyroll, the biggest anime platform all around the world. Crunchyroll also hosts all other previous episodes from the second season, as well as the original weekly anime which aired 5 years ago. At the moment, no breaks have been confirmed for Black Clover, so consistent releases are expected afterwards.
What To Expect From Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5
Black Clover Season 2 has set the bar quite high. With every new episode, exciting new content has either been set up or has directly been delivered to us in the form of new power-ups or enthralling combat. Last week’s episode especially ended on a strong note, as Asta finally made his entrance, and Spade's battle against the supreme-ranking devils that escaped from the First Gate of the Tree of Qliphoth began. With that in mind, Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 will see the continuation of this confrontation.
After tapping into his new powerful transformation, Devil Union, which he achieved through his fusion with Liebe , Asta is simply an unstoppable force right now. Even the most powerful Devils like Lilith and Naamah will not last very long against him as he is. This battle, however, will keep him occupied long enough for other confrontations to erupt all around Spade.
In that sense, Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 will take the attention away from Asta largely and instead give it to other members of the Black Bulls, notably Magna and Zora. Magna and Zora have a tough challenger ahead of them, that being one of the strongest characters currently in Spade, Dante, who has tapped into 100% of his Devil powers. In other words, Dante now has access to powerful Bone Magic, but also the full scale of Lucifero's overpowered Gravity Magic. At first glance, it may seem that Magna and Zora simply have no chance against a foe of this caliber. However, as teased by the Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 preview, Magna has a new trick up his sleeve — Secret Flame Magic: Soul Chain Deathmatch. This ability will even the scales and create an opening to claim victory for the Black Bulls, which will bring us closer to Yami's rescue .
This week, on October 26, 2026, we were treated to preview images from the new episode itself. These preview images gave us an idea of the characters involved and the enemies to face in the next episode. In these preview images, Asta and Nacht are seen clearly, but what we're really excited about is the entrance of Zora and Magna, as well as Dante, with his full devilish powers on display.
“Asta rushes to Nacht’s aid in his moment of crisis. Fusing with Liebe through Devil Union, he confronts Lilith. Meanwhile, Magna and Zora of the Black Bulls arrive to assist Jack, who is battling Dante of the Dark Triad, now wielding 100% of his devil power.
Dante remains confident, boasting an overwhelming amount of magical power. However, Magna unleashes a new spell that he spent six months developing: Secret Flame Magic: Soul Chain Deathmatch!
Even so, Dante remains a formidable opponent thanks to his Body Magic. But Magna refuses to back down, standing his ground against Dante with the very “guts” that earned him Yami’s recognition!” — Official Black Clover Episode 5 Preview by Studio Pierrot

Black Clover Episode 5 Will Be One of the Best Episodes of Season 2
Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 is set to be one of the best episodes of this anime series. When taking a look at the staff listing, it is clear that this episode is also one of the greatest anime releases of 2026 as a whole. This already raises expectations among the fans, and even taking into consideration that the previous Black Clover Season 2 episodes have been highly praised by fans, we can rest assured that this upcoming episode will be a spectacle. From the preview images alone, we can tell that Studio Pierrot is keeping up the high-quality production that has been on display in the previous four episode releases.
The staff involved in this episode also makes it quite a promising one, as it features animation director Hiroyuki Yamashita, a legend who previously worked on the Naruto franchise. He also takes on the role of storyboarding, alongside Takashi Kojima, famous for his recent work on One Piece. Fans might recognize Yamashita from his work on the legendary final battle of Naruto vs. Sasuke in the Naruto Shippuden anime. With him on board, Magna versus Dante is going to be a sight to behold.
As with the previous releases of Black Clover, we can also expect this episode to cover about five chapters of the manga by Yuki Tabata. In other words, Black Clover Season 2 Episode 5 will cover events up until around Chapter 294.
Black Clover Season 2 will be available to stream on Crunchyroll .
